svg.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Telling a double knock from everything else
svg.desc: How a double knock is told apart, as an illustrative trace of the jolt over time. A knock is a jolt of at least 0.25 g after the buddy was still (under 0.08 g); the first needs 150 ms of stillness. The second comes 80 to 700 ms after the first; weaker jolts under 25 % of the first are the buddy rocking and are ignored. 250 ms with no third knock make it a double knock. A screen tap comes with a touch, picking the buddy up keeps it moving, and a third strong jolt cancels the pair.
svg.text: Telling a double knock from everything else
The motion sensor is read every 3 ms. A jolt is the change in acceleration, in every direction.
A double knock, step by step (an illustrative trace)
the buddy rocking on its stand:
A strong jolt, but the touch
never still, so no knock starts.
